data.definition:
Per-brain counts and ranges behind the sentences of Supplementary Section S5 that compare brains in the withheld-slab test,
at the paper's original placements and at both procedures of the test made without the withheld tissue. Nothing is rescored:
every value is read from the test's two records, synthesis_leakfree_ownarm_a19 (slab SSIM per brain, own-b0 arm) and
standin_2x2_a19 (per brain, stand-in arm).
Procedures: envrec = the original placements (control), lfr1 = the registration of the b0 image to the photographs made in
whole without the withheld slab (the lower values), lfr1c = only its deformable stage made without it (the higher values).
The stand-in cells record / CC / CCcc are the same three procedures of the stand-in arm.
Per procedure, own-b0 arm: seen_range and never_seen_range (min and max over the 12 brains); n_seen_above_never_seen (brains
where the network that had seen the brain's other tissue scored higher); mean_seen_minus_never_seen (mean per-brain difference).
Per procedure, stand-in arm: d3p_range (min and max of the stand-in network's SSIM); n_gain_positive (brains where the stand-in
network beat the own-b0 network given the stand-in b0); n_own_above_d3p (brains where the own-b0 network given its own b0 beat
the stand-in network).
